Hi Robert,

I wanted to follow up after our conversation and just say how much we truly enjoyed connecting with you.

We are so grateful to have been introduced through entity["people","Sandra Cook","medspa industry contact"]. It was immediately clear how aligned we are not just in business, but in how we both view the future of this industry and the level of professionalism it needs.

We were incredibly impressed with everything you’ve built, from the full infrastructure and compliance side to the technology and scalability of your platform. It fits so naturally with what we’re doing on the growth and operational side, and it really feels like there is strong potential to create something meaningful together.

We’re especially excited about the opportunity to collaborate across multiple levels, whether that’s supporting med spas together, building out referral pathways, or integrating both of our models in a way that truly elevates the client experience and results.

Looking forward to continuing the conversation with you and Lisa and exploring how we can bring this to life.

Talk soon,  
Bethany
:::
